notes: The built stone of ruin isles lives in the old-world kit (art/models/architecture/old-world/kit.json): monoliths, wall slabs, floor slabs, rings, arches, inlays, glyph plates, and also old-fragment-small/medium/large (floating fragments), old-moss-drape, old-moss-cap, old-root-cluster and old-sapling. This kit holds only the natural layer and loose ruinstone rubble; the sheet's Moss Drapes and Floating Fragments are not repeated here. Channels in ruin biome pieces are dead: dull, unlit dark teal, never emissive (the sheet paints them brighter than intended). Rainwater standing in channels is a shader on the old-world floor slabs, so the kit has no water pieces.

pieces.name: Slab-splitter tree, broad
pieces.notes: Lone gnarled tree, thick twisting light-brown trunk; its roots have split a thick pale ruinstone slab into broken halves and grip the pieces, roots running out over the paving. Wide crown of clumped yellow-green to olive foliage masses.

pieces.name: Slab-splitter tree, slender
pieces.notes: Narrower variant: leaning twisted trunk, a smaller higher crown, roots clasping two cracked slabs.

pieces.name: Root-gripped block
pieces.notes: Precise pale ruinstone cube (about 2 m) with an engraved dead-teal channel and concentric ring motif, toppled; a young tree's roots wrap over and around it, a small leafy crown on top. Matches the cube of ru-rock-a.

pieces.name: Sapling in split block
pieces.notes: Young sapling with a few yellow-green leaves growing from a split small ruinstone block with a dead channel line.

pieces.name: Sapling in paving crack
pieces.notes: Taller sapling with broad bright leaves rising from cracked paving shards, moss at the root. Freestanding counterpart of old-sapling.

pieces.name: Sapling among shards
pieces.notes: Low branching sapling among a few tilted ruinstone shards.

pieces.name: Ivy clump
pieces.notes: Rounded bush of five-lobed ivy leaves, dark green with yellow-green new growth.

pieces.name: Trailing ivy
pieces.notes: Long trailing ivy strand that hangs from a block or lip edge; the pivot is the bottom of its box, the placer snaps its top to an edge.

pieces.name: Joint grass tufts
pieces.notes: Thin tufts of yellow-green grass with seed heads, sized to sit in paving joints and cracks. Alpha cards.

pieces.name: Moss patch
pieces.notes: Mounded olive-green moss cushion dotted with tiny white flowers, plus a few leafy weeds.

pieces.name: Rubble scatter
pieces.notes: Small precise pale ruinstone shards and cubes, sharp edges, scattered loose.

pieces.name: Perfect cube
pieces.notes: Unnaturally smooth pale ivory-grey cube, engraved straight dead-teal channels crossing each face and a ring motif at the centre, hairline cracks, moss at the foot. Loose rubble, not the 4 m old-corner-block.

pieces.name: Sheared slab
pieces.notes: Thick bevelled ruinstone slab broken off at an angle, the break sheared clean and flat like cut glass.

pieces.name: Fallen ring segment
pieces.notes: Toppled broken piece of a large ring (about a quarter to a half arc, square section) with a dead channel along its face, cracked through, moss in the joints. Rubble version of the old-world ring segments, not on their radius grid.

pieces.name: Cracked paving slab
pieces.notes: Square flat ruinstone paving slab, cracked into pieces, engraved dead-teal channels and part of a concentric ring motif, grass in the cracks.

pieces.name: Shard rubble pile
pieces.notes: Heaped pile of precise pale ruinstone shards and broken blocks, moss growing between.

pieces.name: Crumbling lip
pieces.notes: Isle edge segment where pale cracked paving with a dead channel crumbles over ordinary grey rock: broken slab ends, blocks dropping away, wilted browning orange grass on top, pebbles falling from the face.

pieces.name: Paved lip
pieces.notes: Intact counterpart: clean edge of pale ruinstone paving and strata over grey rock, a dead channel turning down the face, ivy over the edge. Derived from the sheet piece and the isle portrait.

pieces.name: Underside spire, large
pieces.notes: Inverted tapering spike: pale ruinstone strata and blocks on top grading into faceted grey rock, a dead dark-teal channel stepping down one face, hanging ivy from the rim, trailing dust and pebbles at the point.

pieces.name: Underside spire, small
pieces.notes: Shorter, stubbier taper of the same rock for narrow edges and small isles. Derived from the sheet piece.
